acceptance_criteria_coverage.ac_description: Users must be redirected to the Dashboard upon successful login.
Passwords must be masked during entry.
An error message must appear for invalid credentials.
The system must prevent "Brute Force" attacks.

identified_coverage_gaps.description: No test validates that the account lockout state resets after the defined cooldown period.
identified_coverage_gaps.recommended_test_scenario: Create a test that triggers the lockout, waits for the configured cooldown period, then attempts a successful login to verify that the lockout is cleared and normal login resumes.

qa_recommendations: Add the lockout‑reset test to address the high‑risk gap in AC‑4.
Include a test that verifies session token expiration and renewal after a period of inactivity.
Automate TC-006 (TLS and logging) where possible by integrating network sniffing into a secure test environment.
Periodically review and update the configurable lockout threshold and cooldown values to align with evolving security policies.
